findings.text: The new condition keeps arm64 on Darwin for v14.17.0 through v14.x, but the added comment says no binary distributions exist before v16. On an Apple Silicon Mac, `nvm install 14.21.3` now requests a darwin-arm64 tarball that doesn't exist, so the download 404s or falls back to a source build. Before the change it used the x64 binary. v15.x still maps to x64, so the version ranges are inconsistent.
